title: Show an experimental-software warning banner in the README and on every page of the public site
summary: Added the maintainer-approved warning that Maestro is experimental, has no warranty and leaves responsibility with the user, under the README title and on all four public site pages. Documentation and site only; no app change.
lessons_learned: The just-the-docs 0.12 header_custom.html hook is hidden on phones, so site-wide banners on docs pages go through an override of components/header.html; refresh that copy on any theme upgrade.
